findings.claim: The wall compositor's per-column store is the ega.drv planar writer, captured live + disassembled from the transient cs=0x6b91 copy (plane-0 store at lin 0x6d9dd). Exact sequence per source column: cx=[bp-6](sub-byte X phase cl); bh = src[si]&src[si+8]&src[si+0x10]&src[si+0x18] (transparency=AND of 4 planes); bl=0xff; stc; rcr bx,cl; dx=bx; not bx; xchg dl,dh (=> bx=set-mask, dx=clear-mask, both rotated by cl). Then per plane p in {0,8,0x10,0x18}: ah=src[si+p]; ax=ah:00; shr ax,cl; and ax,bx; xchg al,ah (=merged); ax = page_word(di+0x2000*planeIdx); and ax,dx; or ax,merged; store WORD page_word. The shr ax,cl IS the per-column horizontal sub-byte convergence (the U placement). di advances +0x28 (one 320px row) per source-row down the screen; si walks an 8x8 4-plane cell (+1 per texel col, +0x18 to next cell-row). VALIDATED: replaying this formula FROM SOURCE matches the engine's actual stored plane-0 word on the source-contributed bits at 100.00% (1936/1936 stores).

findings.claim: ds=0x6a0f (the compositor's source segment) is a MID-FRAME WORK BUFFER that the engine RE-DECODES per FUN_1c94 group (per wall piece). It is NOT a stable wall atlas. PROOF: capturing the atlas at the LAST compositor store and replaying gives 100% source-bit match for the cl=3 (last) group but ~0% for the cl=0 (earlier) groups; capturing the atlas at the FIRST store gives the inverse. u_sampling_law.horizontal: The sub-byte X phase cl (the `shr ax,cl` in the planar writer) places each source texel byte at its sub-byte screen-X position; di selects the page byte-column. Per wall piece (FUN_1c94 group) a contiguous source cell region is blitted into a contiguous page column band with a fixed cl phase per band. The per-depth screen-column SEAMS between bands come from the seam tables @0x36e4/0x3717 (indexed 0x13a*walltype + 2*depth). There is no per-pixel 1/z division — the texture column advances linearly with screen column within a depth band, with the seam tables giving the band boundaries. So it is affine (per-band) column-replicate, not perspective-correct.
u_sampling_law.vertical: The wall quad's vertical extent per depth comes from the convergence arrays @0x42 (left) / @0x4a (right) = {0,104,128,144}/{0,216,192,176} for depths 0..3, added to a perspective bias [bp+4] and parity-selected via [0x521a]. The planar writer walks source cell-rows down the screen (di += 0x28 per row), Y-clipped by [bp+0xe]/[bp+0x14].
u_sampling_law.confidence: medium-high; the affine-vs-perspective distinction confirmed by the linear di/si lockstep within a band + the discrete seam-table band boundaries (no 1/z term in the writer).
